role: Supplemental authentication/ATO research only. Does not replace credential/device/privilege/lateral/exfiltration/remote six-domain goal.
source_limits: Publisher synthesizes feature values from real login behavior. They explicitly prohibit productive IDS use. Historical incident-response ATO labels and attacker-IP indicators are distinct; neither is current user/device/authorization authority.
truth_policy: Validate literal booleans and retain unknown/conflicts. Do not equate failed login, known attack IP, account takeover and policy-denied access. No binary relabeling contract selected yet.
acquisition: Pinned version, exact bytes and publisher MD5 plus local SHA256, bounded4MiB ranged transfer/retry8/max1h, disk headroom before start. No archive execution or whole member extraction.
probe: Only header and first128 CSV data records may be inspected as development schema probe after full archive integrity verification. All later CSV records remain quarantined pending a separate partition/label protocol. Probe users/events cannot later be called unseen final data.
archive: Inventory only before member read. ZIP may contain a large CSV; existing generic512MiB member extraction cap stays unchanged. Any subsequent prefix/stream reader needs its own decompression/record bound and must not claim full member CRC from a prefix read.
input_limits: No fabricated active identity, managed/healthy device, MFA, owner role or business approval. Pseudonyms support linkage only; browser/device type is not physical device posture.
